GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when the authenticated member wants to view their own library activity, such as recent interactions or updates, using their server-validated session token.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about viewing the member's own library activity, use LibraryAgentMyActivityAction.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide the authenticated member with their own library activity details using the server-validated session token. You cannot provide activity details for any other member or perform any write operations.
